title: China gets a launch date: CMS Classic opens August 3
original_title: China gets a launch date: CMS Classic opens August 3 | NiaMeowDB
author: NiaMeowDB
summary: Shengqu announced that the Chinese Classic server launches for real on August 3, 2026. This is a full launch, not a test, and Shengqu says it is built to run long term. At launch you get five classes (Warrior, Mage, Bowman, Thief, and Pirate), a level cap of 100 with the second job change, classic areas like Victoria Island and the Nautilus, and Free Market personal and hired-merchant shops. Pre-registration is open on the official site.

sections.title: Launch date and server status
items: China MapleStory Classic is scheduled to open on August 3, 2026.
Shengqu describes this as the full, permanent service launch rather than another closed or time-limited test.
The official wording emphasizes long-term operation, so launch characters and progress are intended for the live service rather than a test wipe.

sections.title: Content available at launch
items: The initial class selection covers the five classic Adventurer branches: Warrior, Magician, Bowman, Thief, and Pirate.
The opening level cap is 100, with progression through the second job advancement included in the announced launch scope.
Confirmed explorable areas include classic Victoria Island locations and the Nautilus, the Pirate starting hub.

sections.title: Trading and the Free Market
items: The Free Market is part of the launch version rather than a feature deferred to a later update.
Both player-operated personal shops and hired-merchant shops are named, establishing player-to-player trading as a launch-day system.
Prices, shop restrictions, currency rules, and anti-abuse measures were not specified in the indexed announcement and should not be inferred.

sections.title: Registration and timing
items: Pre-registration is open through the official Shengqu China MapleStory Classic website.
The second Chinese closed test is scheduled to end on July 15, leaving 19 days between that test ending and the August 3 live launch.
No unconfirmed registration deadline, launch-hour timestamp, reward list, or account requirement has been added by MPStorys.

sections.title: What this means for Global MapleStory Classic
items: The August 3 date applies to the Chinese service operated by Shengqu; it is not a Global MapleStory Classic release date.
Global Closed Online Test #2 is scheduled for August 4–12, after the Chinese live service opens.
Because the Chinese and Global versions have different operators, test schedules, and service rules, the China date should not be used to predict the Global launch.

sections.title: Source distinction
items: The launch facts originate from Shengqu's official Chinese announcement, linked below as the first-party reference.
NiaMeowDB is an independent fan site; its comparison with the Global test schedule is commentary, not a Nexon or Shengqu statement.
MPStorys preserves this distinction so confirmed launch facts are not mixed with regional-release speculation.
